# Portal end of entry point 1, broken (as spawned).
ahw_gate_broken_1 = {
	entity = "deactivated_gateway_entity"
	portrait = "GFX_megastructure_construction_background"
	place_entity_on_planet_plane = no
	show_galactic_map_icon = no
	show_in_outliner = yes
	construction_blocks_and_blocked_by = none
	bypass_type = ahw_link_1

	potential = { always = no }
	dismantle_potential = { always = no }
	nomad_reactivatable = yes
}

# Portal end of entry point 1, repaired: an upgrade of the broken gate.
ahw_gate_1 = {
	entity = "reactivated_gateway_entity"
	portrait = "GFX_megastructure_construction_background"
	place_entity_on_planet_plane = no
	show_galactic_map_icon = no
	show_in_outliner = yes
	construction_blocks_and_blocked_by = none
	bypass_type = ahw_link_1

	upgrade_from = {
		ahw_gate_broken_1
	}
	potential = {
		OR = {
			has_country_flag = ahw_highway_studied
			is_nomadic = yes
		}
		# run 42: a nomad on our repair contract shuttled between the anchor (the contract's work)
		# and the portal - presumably to reactivate the gate whenever it had lost its owner
		# (save 2200.07.23: unowned; the monthly check gives it back). Under contract, the contract
		# is its only way to repair.
		NOT = { has_event_chain = ahw_contract_repair_gate_chain }
	}
	possible = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			fail_text = AHW_REPAIR_NEEDS_TECHS
			from = {
				has_technology = ahw_tech_gate_theory
				has_technology = ahw_tech_gate_construction
			}
		}
	}
	build_time = 90
	resources = {
		category = megastructures
		cost = {
			alloys = 300
			influence = 50
		}
	}
	on_build_complete = {
		# run 41: finished by script (the contract), `from` is the gate's owner, not the nomad -
		# ahw_repair_gate hands the real repairer over in a global target
		if = {
			limit = { exists = event_target:ahw_script_repairer }
			event_target:ahw_script_repairer = { save_event_target_as = ahw_repairer }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { exists = from }
			from = { save_event_target_as = ahw_repairer }
		}
		solar_system = { ahw_mark_repaired = yes }
	}
	dismantle_potential = { always = no }
	overclock_loc_key = AHW_SEAL
	overclock_cooldown = 30
	overclock_types = {
		ahw_gate_open
		ahw_gate_sealed
	}
}

			limit = { exists = event_target:ahw_script_repairer }
			event_target:ahw_script_repairer = { save_event_target_as = ahw_repairer }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { exists = from }
			from = { save_event_target_as = ahw_repairer }
		}
		solar_system = { ahw_mark_repaired = yes }
	}
	dismantle_potential = { always = no }
	overclock_loc_key = AHW_SEAL
	overclock_cooldown = 30
	overclock_types = {
		ahw_gate_open
		ahw_gate_sealed
	}
}

# Portal end of entry point 9, repaired: an upgrade of the broken gate.
ahw_gate_9 = {
	entity = "reactivated_gateway_entity"
	portrait = "GFX_megastructure_construction_background"
	place_entity_on_planet_plane = no
	show_galactic_map_icon = no
	show_in_outliner = yes
	construction_blocks_and_blocked_by = none
	bypass_type = ahw_link_9

	upgrade_from = {
		ahw_gate_broken_9
	}
	potential = {
		OR = {
			has_country_flag = ahw_highway_studied
			is_nomadic = yes
		}
		# run 42: a nomad on our repair contract shuttled between the anchor (the contract's work)
		# and the portal - presumably to reactivate the gate whenever it had lost its owner
		# (save 2200.07.23: unowned; the monthly check gives it back). Under contract, the contract
		# is its only way to repair.
		NOT = { has_event_chain = ahw_contract_repair_gate_chain }
	}
	possible = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			fail_text = AHW_REPAIR_NEEDS_TECHS
			from = {
				has_technology = ahw_tech_gate_theory
				has_technology = ahw_tech_gate_construction
			}
		}
	}
	build_time = 90
	resources = {
		category = megastructures
		cost = {
			alloys = 300
			influence = 50
		}
	}
	on_build_complete = {
		# run 41: finished by script (the contract), `from` is the gate's owner, not the nomad -
		# ahw_repair_gate hands the real repairer over in a global target
		if = {
			limit = { exists = event_target:ahw_script_repairer }
			event_target:ahw_script_repairer = { save_event_target_as = ahw_repairer }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { exists = from }
			from = { save_event_target_as = ahw_repairer }
		}
		solar_system = { ahw_mark_repaired = yes }
	}
	dismantle_potential = { always = no }
	overclock_loc_key = AHW_SEAL
	overclock_cooldown = 30
	overclock_types = {
		ahw_gate_open
		ahw_gate_sealed
	}
}

		# run 42: a nomad on our repair contract shuttled between the anchor (the contract's work)
		# and the portal - presumably to reactivate the gate whenever it had lost its owner

				has_technology = ahw_tech_gate_construction

	portrait = "GFX_megastructure_construction_background"
	place_entity_on_planet_plane = no
	show_galactic_map_icon = no
	show_in_outliner = yes
	construction_blocks_and_blocked_by = none
	bypass_type = ahw_link_24

	potential = { always = no }
	dismantle_potential = { always = no }
	nomad_reactivatable = yes
}

# Portal end of entry point 24, repaired: an upgrade of the broken gate.
ahw_gate_24 = {
	entity = "reactivated_gateway_entity"
	portrait = "GFX_megastructure_construction_background"
	place_entity_on_planet_plane = no
	show_galactic_map_icon = no
	show_in_outliner = yes
	construction_blocks_and_blocked_by = none
	bypass_type = ahw_link_24

	upgrade_from = {
		ahw_gate_broken_24
	}
	potential = {
		OR = {
			has_country_flag = ahw_highway_studied
			is_nomadic = yes
		}
		# run 42: a nomad on our repair contract shuttled between the anchor (the contract's work)
		# and the portal - presumably to reactivate the gate whenever it had lost its owner
		# (save 2200.07.23: unowned; the monthly check gives it back). Under contract, the contract
		# is its only way to repair.
		NOT = { has_event_chain = ahw_contract_repair_gate_chain }
	}
	possible = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			fail_text = AHW_REPAIR_NEEDS_TECHS
			from = {
				has_technology = ahw_tech_gate_theory
				has_technology = ahw_tech_gate_construction
			}
		}
	}
	build_time = 90
	resources = {
		category = megastructures
		cost = {
			alloys = 300
			influence = 50
		}
	}
	on_build_complete = {
		# run 41: finished by script (the contract), `from` is the gate's owner, not the nomad -
		# ahw_repair_gate hands the real repairer over in a global target
		if = {
			limit = { exists = event_target:ahw_script_repairer }
			event_target:ahw_script_repairer = { save_event_target_as = ahw_repairer }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { exists = from }
			from = { save_event_target_as = ahw_repairer }
		}
		solar_system = { ahw_mark_repaired = yes }
	}
	dismantle_potential = { always = no }
	overclock_loc_key = AHW_SEAL
	overclock_cooldown = 30
	overclock_types = {
		ahw_gate_open
		ahw_gate_sealed
	}
}

# Ring end of entry point 24: never dismantled.
ahw_exitgate_24 = {
	entity = "reactivated_gateway_entity"
	portrait = "GFX_megastructure_construction_background"
	place_entity_on_planet_plane = no
	show_galactic_map_icon = no
	show_in_outliner = yes
	construction_blocks_and_blocked_by = none
	bypass_type = ahw_link_24

	potential = { always = no }
	dismantle_potential = { always = no }
}

	}
	potential = {
		OR = {
			has_country_flag = ahw_highway_studied
			is_nomadic = yes
		}
		# run 42: a nomad on our repair contract shuttled between the anchor (the contract's work)
		# and the portal - presumably to reactivate the gate whenever it had lost its owner

			limit = { exists = event_target:ahw_script_repairer }

			from = { save_event_target_as = ahw_repairer }
		}
		solar_system = { ahw_mark_repaired = yes }
	}
	dismantle_potential = { always = no }
	overclock_loc_key = AHW_SEAL
	overclock_cooldown = 30
	overclock_types = {
		ahw_gate_open
		ahw_gate_sealed
	}
}

# Ring end of entry point 31: never dismantled.
ahw_exitgate_31 = {
	entity = "reactivated_gateway_entity"
	portrait = "GFX_megastructure_construction_background"
	place_entity_on_planet_plane = no
	show_galactic_map_icon = no
	show_in_outliner = yes
	construction_blocks_and_blocked_by = none
	bypass_type = ahw_link_31

	potential = { always = no }
	dismantle_potential = { always = no }
}

# Portal end of entry point 32, broken (as spawned).
ahw_gate_broken_32 = {
	entity = "deactivated_gateway_entity"
	portrait = "GFX_megastructure_construction_background"
	place_entity_on_planet_plane = no
	show_galactic_map_icon = no
	show_in_outliner = yes
	construction_blocks_and_blocked_by = none
	bypass_type = ahw_link_32

	potential = { always = no }
	dismantle_potential = { always = no }
	nomad_reactivatable = yes
}

# Portal end of entry point 32, repaired: an upgrade of the broken gate.
ahw_gate_32 = {
	entity = "reactivated_gateway_entity"
	portrait = "GFX_megastructure_construction_background"
	place_entity_on_planet_plane = no
	show_galactic_map_icon = no
	show_in_outliner = yes
	construction_blocks_and_blocked_by = none
	bypass_type = ahw_link_32

	upgrade_from = {
		ahw_gate_broken_32
	}
	potential = {
		OR = {
			has_country_flag = ahw_highway_studied
			is_nomadic = yes
		}
		# run 42: a nomad on our repair contract shuttled between the anchor (the contract's work)
		# and the portal - presumably to reactivate the gate whenever it had lost its owner
		# (save 2200.07.23: unowned; the monthly check gives it back). Under contract, the contract
		# is its only way to repair.
		NOT = { has_event_chain = ahw_contract_repair_gate_chain }
	}
	possible = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			fail_text = AHW_REPAIR_NEEDS_TECHS
			from = {
				has_technology = ahw_tech_gate_theory
				has_technology = ahw_tech_gate_construction
			}
		}
	}
	build_time = 90
	resources = {
		category = megastructures
		cost = {
			alloys = 300
			influence = 50
		}
	}
	on_build_complete = {
		# run 41: finished by script (the contract), `from` is the gate's owner, not the nomad -
		# ahw_repair_gate hands the real repairer over in a global target
		if = {
			limit = { exists = event_target:ahw_script_repairer }
			event_target:ahw_script_repairer = { save_event_target_as = ahw_repairer }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { exists = from }
			from = { save_event_target_as = ahw_repairer }
		}
		solar_system = { ahw_mark_repaired = yes }
	}
	dismantle_potential = { always = no }
	overclock_loc_key = AHW_SEAL
	overclock_cooldown = 30
	overclock_types = {
		ahw_gate_open
		ahw_gate_sealed
	}
}

# Ring end of entry point 32: never dismantled.

	portrait = "GFX_megastructure_construction_background"
	place_entity_on_planet_plane = no
	show_galactic_map_icon = no
	show_in_outliner = yes
	construction_blocks_and_blocked_by = none
	bypass_type = ahw_link_32

	potential = { always = no }
	dismantle_potential = { always = no }
}
